الطبعة التاسعة عشرة من مسابقة نجمة الإعل: The 19th edition of the Media Star competition
Ooredoo تمنح الصحفيين مهلة استثنائية إضا: Ooredoo grants journalists an additional exceptional deadline to participate in the competition
• تمديد آخر أجل لإرسال الترشيحات إلى غاي: • Extension of the final deadline for submitting entries until September 15, 2026
الجزائر، 1 سبتمبر 2026 ꞉ حرصًا منها على: Algiers, September 1, 2026: Driven by its commitment to enabling journalists to benefit from sufficient time to complete their work and submit their application files, Ooredoo, following the approval of the jury, announces an exceptional extension of the participation deadline for the 19th edition of its Media Star journalism competition
وبعد أن كان آخر أجل محددًا في البداية لي: Initially set for August 31, 2026, the deadline for receiving applications has been extended to Tuesday, September 15, 2026.
ويأتي هذا التمديد استجابةً للطلبات التي: This extension comes in response to requests made by a number of journalists who expressed their desire to benefit from an additional period allowing them to complete their work and submit their entries under the best conditions.
تتناول الطبعة التاسعة عشرة من مسابقة نجم: The 19th edition of the Media Star competition addresses the theme: "The impact of artificial intelligence and 5G technology on socio-economic transformations in Algeria."
ومن خلال هذه الطبعة، تتيح المسابقة للصحف: Through this edition, the competition offers journalists the opportunity to highlight the various transformations related to the development of artificial intelligence and 5G technology in Algeria, analyze the opportunities and challenges they present, and showcase their repercussions on the economic and social transformations witnessed by the country.
ويتعين أن تكون الأعمال الصحفية المشاركة،: The participating journalistic works, in Arabic, Tamazight, French, or English, must have been published or broadcasted during the period from August 15, 2025, to September 15, 2026.
ويمكن للصحفيين الراغبين في المشاركة إرسا: Journalists wishing to participate can submit their application files via the dedicated competition platform ore.do/media-star-participation:
كما يمكن إرسال ملفات الترشح عبر البريد ا: Application files can also be sent via email to the following address: MediaStar@Ooredoo.dz
وتدعو Ooredoo الجزائر كافة الصحفيين الرا: Ooredoo Algeria invites all journalists wishing to participate to take advantage of this exceptional extension and utilize this additional timeframe to complete their work and submit their application files before Tuesday, September 15, 2026.
